serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Cashier.Face.shocked
Shanice: What are you guys doing here?!
#bot.Expression.veryhappy
Bot: It’s Shanice! How have you been?! 
Shanice: Fine, thanks for asking. 
#Cashier.Face.normal
#Nun_NewOutfit.Eyes.Really
Shanice: Am I right to assume that you three have a nice karaoke party going on here?
Bot: That’s right!
Shanice: I hope you don’t mind if someone were to crash in~
Bot: Of course not!
#Nun_NewOutfit.Eyes.Normal
#bot.Expression.happy
Shanice: I see that you two have a new friend. 
#Nun_NewOutfit.ArmL.Palm
Shanice: Hello, I’m Shanice! Nice to meet you!
Melissa: Likewise. I’m Melissa.
#Nun_NewOutfit.Eyes.Really
Shanice: Hmmm…{{wi}} Now that I look at you closer, Melissa, you seem like a rather interesting person!
#Nun_NewOutfit.Mouth.Smile
Shanice: I will ask for details later, but for now let’s start singing!
#Nun_NewOutfit.Eyes.Normal
You: Don’t worry, Melissa. Shanice is a friend, she can be trusted.
#Cashier.Eyes.closed+Cashier.Mouth.open
Melissa: I figured as much, but I swear, you have the most peculiar acquaintances…
#Cashier.Face.normal
You: You can take the next turn, Shanice.
Shanice: Really?! Don’t mind if I do!
For the next few hours we took turns singing and had a blast.
